definition: Profit or loss before finance costs, exceptional items and tax, including the source’s corporate unallocated line.
location: Consolidated segment information · year ended 31 March 2026
notes: Revenue includes other income and other operating revenue, which includes sales of gold ingots (10,568 in the year, per the filed notes). Titan’s earnings release leaves out bullion and digi-gold sales from its headline total income, so that headline differs from this table. Segment profit is before a 101 exceptional item, a one-off cost of the new Labour Codes (new wage and labour rules).
insight: Jewellery dominates both revenue and segment profit. Watches contribute a smaller sales base but meaningful profit; corporate costs reduce the combined result.
